notablePrerequisites: You control five or more enchantments.
easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Evil Twin.
description:
Cast Evil Twin by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Evil Twin into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Evil Twin's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Evil Twin's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Evil Twin's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.
